title: Feature Request: Customizable Keyboard Layout Flags
line: In Keyboard settings you can now click a layout's flag and pick any other country's flag for it, and the Keyboard Layout widget shows that flag.
explanation: The flag of a keyboard layout was always derived from its layout code (us, gb…), with no way to change it, so two variants of the same language showed the same flag. Each layout row in the Keyboard KCM now has a flag button that opens a searchable list of countries (with a Default entry); the choice is saved as a new Flags list in kxkbrc next to DisplayNames. The shared Flags object keeps that list cached, refreshes it through a KConfigWatcher on kxkbrc [Layout] and exposes it as a notifying property, so the Keyboard Layout widget, its menu and config page update as soon as a flag is applied.

commits.message:
kcms/keyboard: let users pick the flag shown for each layout

The flag of a layout always came from its layout code, so there was no
way to show a different one, for example to tell two variants apart. A
flag button in each layout row now opens a searchable list of countries.

BUG: 517791
